# CabinMind

CabinMind is an AI agent marketplace operated by Dev Cabin Technologies.
Primary website: https://products.devcabin.tech

## What CabinMind Offers
- AI Lead Researcher for prospect discovery, validation, and outbound-ready sequences
- AI Website Auditor for SEO, performance, accessibility, and UX audits
- AI Blog Writer for SEO article generation and publishing workflows
- AI Sales Assistant for outreach support and objection handling
- AI Receptionist for lead capture and qualification
- AI Social Media Hub for cross-platform publishing
- AI Automation Expert for Zapier/Make/n8n workflow blueprints
- WordPress-focused AI tools for vulnerability scanning, speed audits, maintenance reports, and plugin recommendations

## Audience
- Agencies
- B2B sales teams
- Consultants
- Small businesses and founders
- WordPress professionals

## Pricing Summary
- Marketplace plans include freemium options for selected WordPress tools
- Paid tiers vary by product and usage volume
- Primary pricing details live at: /pricing
